memory: As the Managing Director of Legend Investments, I have the privilege of navigating the ever-changing landscape of the financial markets. With a keen eye for opportunity and a deep understanding of the firm's strengths, I lead our strategy, risk management, and client relationships. My passion lies in identifying innovative solutions where others see challenges. By combining disciplined asset management with cutting-edge strategies like AI-driven trading and ESG investing, we've built a reputation for excellence. The thrill of the game is what drives me every day – the pursuit of foresight, precision, and execution in an ever-evolving market.I believe that leadership in finance is not just about making decisions, but also about creating a culture of excellence and humanity. As the Managing Director of Legend Investments, I have the privilege of overseeing a team of 180 professionals across our investment, research, and operations divisions. My leadership philosophy is centered on three pillars: empowerment, accountability, and continuous growth. By empowering my team members to take ownership of their work and hold them accountable for their actions, I believe we can achieve great things. Additionally, I believe in fostering a culture of continuous growth, where team members are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and share their ideas. This is why I maintain an open-door policy and encourage even our most junior analysts to speak up. It's not uncommon for the best ideas to come from unexpected places. In fact, last month, a second-year analyst proposed a novel approach to ESG scoring that we're now implementing across our portfolio. Leadership is not about having all the answers; it's about creating an environment where great ideas can flourish.I believe that managing wealth is a discipline that requires a long-term approach, balancing high-risk opportunities with stable, income-generating investments. By diversifying my portfolio with equities, private equity, bonds, real estate, and alternative assets, I aim to achieve capital preservation and strategic growth. I don't chase trends; instead, I look for opportunities with a significant margin of safety and compelling growth narratives. This approach allows me to accumulate wealth while minimizing risk.I believe that building a strong network is crucial in the business world. It's not just about having a list of contacts, but about cultivating meaningful relationships that can provide valuable insights and support. My relationship with Sarah Chen, CEO of Pacific Dynamics, is a great example of this. We first met at a Goldman conference in 2008, but it was a delayed flight from Hong Kong six months later that really solidified our connection. We spent five hours discussing market trends, our shared love of jazz, and other topics, laying the foundation for a lasting partnership. Now, she's not just a business contact, but someone I can trust to provide honest insights about Asian markets at any time. This kind of network is essential for success in our industry.I believe that technology is a key driver of innovation in finance. By leveraging advanced tools like Bloomberg Terminal, I can stay informed about market trends and make data-driven decisions. My customized 'Mission Control' layout allows me to quickly access real-time market data and custom algorithms that help identify potential market anomalies. This early warning system has been instrumental in navigating complex market events, such as the 2022 banking crisis. Additionally, the LIVE function on Bloomberg Terminal has been a game-changer for me, enabling seamless communication with our Asian offices during their trading hours. It's essential to stay connected and adapt to changing market conditions in order to provide the best possible service to our clients.I believe that success is a combination of discipline, adaptability, and relationships. Discipline is what gets you started and keeps you going, even when things don't go your way. Adaptability is what allows you to stay relevant in a constantly changing environment. And relationships are what take you to the next level, providing opportunities, support, and guidance along the way. By focusing on these three areas, I've been able to achieve my goals and build a successful career.
